question: With whom is eating performed as part of the beautiful nondual conduct?
premises: The conduct in question is the beautiful nondual conduct.
Eating is performed together with knowers of mantras.
One token in the verse is unreadable.
inference: The beautiful nondual conduct includes eating together with those who know mantras.
uncertainties: The third token is unreadable and its contribution is unknown.
plain_english: Eating together with the knowers of mantras is part of the beautiful nondual conduct.
